application-form-single-validation.title: 申請フォーム（1ページ・検証エラー）

application-form-single-validation.html:
<main data-dads-typeset>
  <dads-heading level="1">申請フォーム</dads-heading>
  <form id="application-form-single">
    <dads-fieldset>
      <legend>申請情報</legend>
      <dads-input-text label="氏名" name="name" required error error-text="氏名は必須です"></dads-input-text>
      <dads-select label="種別" name="type" required></dads-select>
      <dads-textarea label="理由" name="reason" required></dads-textarea>
    </dads-fieldset>
    <dads-button type="submit">送信</dads-button>
  </form>
</main>

mockup-mobile-form.title: モックアップ（Mobile Form）
mockup-mobile-form.description: モバイル端末上で入力フォームの配置と余白を確認するモックアップ。
mockup-mobile-form.html:
<section data-dads-typeset>
  <dads-device-mock device="mobile" visible-height="560px">
    <main>
      <dads-heading level="2">申請フォーム</dads-heading>
      <form>
        <dads-fieldset>
          <legend>基本情報</legend>
          <dads-input-text label="氏名" name="name" required></dads-input-text>
          <dads-select label="種別" name="type" required></dads-select>
          <dads-textarea label="詳細" name="detail" required></dads-textarea>
        </dads-fieldset>
        <dads-button type="submit">確認へ進む</dads-button>
      </form>
    </main>
  </dads-device-mock>
</section>
mockup-mobile-form.behavior: // Mockups are visual-only; no runtime behavior needed.
